description: Records whether mission flow artifacts can be mirrored through native Paperclip issue artifacts. Based on S02 route probe results: auth is definitively broken (401 on all company routes), document and comment routes are unsupported (no observed route, plugin routes returning 404), and no confirmation scope exists. Mirror mode is repo-local-fallback.

issue.create.reason: issue.create requires valid Paperclip auth AND explicit user confirmation. Auth returns 401 on all company routes. Mutation cannot be attempted.

document.create.reason: document.create has never been independently observed as a working route. Plugin routes are returning 404 and tool routes are not found. No confirmation scope was established for document writes.

comment.create.reason: comment.create has never been independently observed as a working route. Plugin routes are returning 404 and tool routes are not found. No confirmation scope was established for comment writes.

issue.read.reason: issue.read (listing/viewing issues) returns 401 Unauthorized. Auth key is present but not authorized for company routes.

readbackDetails: No native Paperclip artifacts were created. Auth is broken (401 on all company routes). Document and comment routes are unsupported. No live issue ID exists to read back. Readback is not applicable for repo-local-fallback mode.

resolutionRequired: Provide fresh Paperclip API key (replace PAPERCLIP_API_KEY in .env)
Or provide correct password for kabidenov.a@gmail.com (replace PAPERCLIP_PASSWORD in .env)
Or register with a different email address
Then obtain explicit user confirmation (paperclip_mutation_yes) before mutation

capabilityGateReference.reconciliationNote: artifact.issue_document_comment_native is historically confirmed but current S02 reprobe shows auth-blocked and unsupported routes. This is not a downgrade of prior proofs, but it blocks fresh authenticated readback until auth is restored.
